name: harness-npm-tools
description: npm-distributed parts of the harness bundle: pi (SDK, TUI, AI), the bundled pi packages, the npm MCP servers, and harness's own dependencies (typebox, yaml, ignore, jiti; diff for the changes of a subagent's plan; ws for the hub's WebSocket endpoint; qrcode for device pairing links; pi-ask-user, whose ask_user prompt the TUI draws; @modelcontextprotocol/server, zod and patchright for the browser MCP server; node-pty, @xterm/headless and @xterm/addon-serialize for the operator's terminal of a session, @xterm/headless also for the test stand's screen captures; pngjs to compare screens with their baselines). Versions are bumped by nix/update.sh; package-lock.json is generated, never edited by hand.
